method: Read-only inspection of the frozen source documentation and validation record; primary vendor documentation and selected research publications. No new product or detection benchmark.

recorded_validation.claim_boundary: Counts are checked-in historical results, not tests rerun for publication or proof of threat-detection effectiveness.
